name: Online Course (Teachable / Gumroad / Udemy)

yield.notes: Requires existing audience or strong SEO/ads. Self-hosted (Teachable) vs marketplace (Udemy) tradeoffs in reach vs revenue share.

flags: Teachable charges 0-10% transaction fee depending on plan
Course content can become outdated requiring updates

prerequisites: Screen recording software (Loom free, OBS free)
startup_checklist: Choose topic where you have genuine expertise (at least 12 months experience)
Validate demand: search Udemy and Teachable for similar courses with students enrolled
Record first module, get feedback from 3 beta testers before completing course
Launch with early-bird pricing to first 10 students; collect testimonials
failure_modes: Course attracts no students without existing audience
Udemy algorithm buries course in competitive category
Refund rate >10% signals course quality issues
kill_criteria: Less than 10 paid students after 6 months of promotion
sources_note: Revenue ranges from Teachable/Udemy creator community data.
